title: Private Pool House, Heart of Rincon
description: Keep it simple and enjoy a refreshing swimming experience at this peaceful, centrally-located pool house with exotic countryside views of Rincon. Located less than 3 minutes to both beaches and the center of Downtown Rincon, this ultra private and exclusive enclave offers a private mini pool, outdoor deck, and spectacular views. Enjoy a King sized bed, full bathroom and kitchen. This home is located in a private, gated entry street, offering optimum safety and security.Guest accessThis is a private guest suite in a very quiet, safe, gated community. Guests are renting the entire suite with a private pool and outdoor deck. There are no shared or common spaces. There is private parking directly in front of the suite.Other things to notePropertyThis is a private Guest Suite (attached to a larger home) with its own entrance, parking, pool and outdoor deck. There are no shared or common spaces. We currently only accommodate two adult guests — no infants or children permitted for safety reasons. By booking this home, you consent to swimming at your own risk. Total depth is 4 feet. Please be careful. No diving or rough play by pool. No glass outside on deck or in pool. No life guard on duty. Thank you!CancellationsWe understand that life happens. As a small business providing local employment, we hope that you understand our need to maintain a consistent cancellationpolicy. We recommend purchasing trip insurance that covers expenses from last-minute cancellations of lodging and transportation due to theft, medical, etc. Airbnb and Travel Guard offer affordable options to ensure you're covered in the event of the unexpected.PestsPlease note that since we are located on a tropical island, from time to time you may see a dead bug or two in the cottage, especially with warmer and warmer temperatures. This is normal, to be expected and cannot be avoided. Doors should remain closed when possible to minimize pests (i.e. when loading/unloading the car, taking out the trash or hanging out on the porch). Bugs can get inside easily, especially in warmer weather. The cottage is treated inside & out by a pest control company for your comfort and safety.We stay on top of this costly pest control so please help us keep it effective - thank you!Local AnimalsWe love animals and rescued a Puerto Rican “sato” (stray dog), however we kindly ask that you do not feed any stray cats or dogs that are encountered in and around the property. If you feed them they stay and persistently seek more food which becomes difficult and uncomfortable for us as hosts and for other guests, especially those with severe allergies to animals. Let us know if you’d like to rescue a dog or cat, and we can help you!

description: Our Eco-friendly, upcycled shipping container is a newly remodeled 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom gem. Sleeps 21 Queen bedSmart TVFree WiFiNew ACs Indoor living roomOutdoor veranda with full kitchen and comfortable lounge area.And best of all we're located in Puerto Rico's most popular beach town, Rincon!!The spaceWelcome to your Puerto Rican beach vacation! This 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom beach house is located directly across the street from Playa Corcega. One of Rincon's favorite beaches for swimming, sunbathing, snorkling and catching stunning sunsets with views of Desecheo Island in the distance. The house has been recently remodeled in a relaxed white boho-beach style and features a colorful mural of a sunbathing lady - part of the "Beautiful Beach Ladies" series by a talented young artist. You'll spot her artwork throughout the park, celebrating women of all ages, backgrounds, and body types in joyful, seaside scenes.Inside the home, you'll find AC in every room, blackout curtains in both bedrooms, full-length mirrors, closets, a queen pull-out sleeper sofa, smart TV and free WiFi for your convenience. The kitchen is well equipped with full sized appliances; refrigerator, freezer, range with oven and stove-top, microwave, coffee pot and small smoothie blender - perfect for beach day meal prep. Beach towels, bath towels and bed linens are included, and the front porch has hammock hooks for island-style relaxing (bring your own hammock!).You'll have direct access to one of the last remaining small sandy stretches of Corcega Beach - ideal for swimming, lounging, snorkeling, and sunbathing. We offer beach chairs and umbrellas for rent, and ice and propane for sale. Our friendly local staff is always nearby to help with anything you might need.The freshly remodeled home is designed in a relaxed white boho-beach style, featuring a colorful mural by a talented young artist; part of the beautiful beach ladies series throughout the park. The modern boho design boast a smart TV, complimentary WiFi and new AC units for cooling off after a fun day on the beach. Murals by a talented young artist adorn the walls, giving the space a beac-hy and artistic flair. Location:Nestled in a mixed-use beachfront property, you'll have direct access to a sandy beaches and the clear caribbean waters of Rincon. The park on the beach is perfect for leisurely strolls, picnics, fun in the sun and is well know for it beautiful sunsets! With it's charming campground feel, this park has been a cherished weekend getaway spot for the local community for over 20 years. Experience the friendly, laid-back atmosphere that has made this area a beloved retreat for generations.Other things to noteDirections: From Carr. 115/PR-115 turn right on Calle 11. Drive straight towards the ocean. Turn left on Calle 10. Drive to the last house. Turn left after the house. The office is a container unit on your right behind our boutique hotel (the big white building on the ocean with brown trim.If you arrive after hours, your unit is located by continuing straight on the rocky path turn right at the end drive straight to the next path ending and turn right again the container building is on your right.To receive your personalized access code before arrival, please complete the property agreement and provide the make, model, color and license plate of your vehicle. Once those are in place, you'll receive your code on the day of arrival. Most guest complete this within a few minuets, before their check-in to ensure a smooth arrival.We're ready on our end, just send over the details when you are.As we are located on a tropical island, power outages can occasionally occur. While we do everything we can to ensure a comfortable stay, we are not responsible for area-wide outages that are beyond our control. description: Beachfront and completely remodeled. A 4 bedrooms home with a secluded beach access and amazing sunsets. Casa Ruby is a beachfront heaven that offers: Private stairs directly to the beach, perfect for swimming, snorkeling, spearfishing or simply basking in the sun. Breathtaking sunsets every evening overlooking Desecheo island. Fully remodeled interior features modern appliances, and comfortable living spaces. Tranquil Ambiance with soothing ocean sounds and gentle sea breeze. Just a Dream!The spaceOur stunning half-acre oceanfront property offers a tranquil atmosphere and breathtaking views, perfect for a relaxing getaway. The 4-bedroom beachfront cottage has 3 queen size beds in each room and 1 room with 2 twin beds with a total of 1300 sq ft. The property features direct access to a secluded beach, where private stairs lead down to crystal-clear waters ideal for snorkeling, swimming, and relaxation.The fully-remodeled interior showcases brand-new furniture and modern appliances, including a fully-equipped kitchen for effortless meal prep. The outdoor lounge area is perfect for sunset-watching and relaxation, and the outdoor shower is great for rinsing off after a beach day.To ensure your comfort, we have installed solar panels with a backup battery to keep all the house essentials running in case of a power outage, which happens frequently on the island.Enjoy breathtaking sunsets every day, just 8 minutes from Rincon town center with its vibrant shopping, dining, and nightlife scene. Plus, take a short drive to world-class surfing beaches in Rincon, where you can catch waves at famous spots like Maria's Beach, Domes Beach, and more.Guest access- Exclusive access to the entire oceanfront property- Private access to secluded beach via stairs- Steps away from Playa Los Almendros and the iconic Bote De Millán- Use of outdoor lounge area and outdoor shower- Parking for multiple vehicles- Short drive to world-class surfing beaches, Rincon town center, shopping, dining, and nightlife- Most vibrant reef in the area for spearfishing!Rincon is a surfer's paradise and one of the top wave destinations in the Americas. This charming beach town embodies the warmth and richness of Puerto Rican culture, blending the laid-back spirit of 1970s Malibu with the authentic beach lifestyle of 1980s North Shore Oahu. Rincon's eclectic vibe is complemented by its unique boutiques, oceanfront bars, healthy eateries, yoga studios, and abundance of land and water activities. As the sun sets, the town comes alive with a distinctive nightlife that's quintessentially Rincon.Other things to note- No Pets- No Smoking- 6 Guest Maximum- No Parties- Noise ordinance strictly enforced

description: Spacious and Bright Beach House with Ocean ViewThis charming beach house is spacious and full of natural light. It features a terrace with spectacular ocean views where you can listen to the waves and enjoy unforgettable sunsets. It’s located right in front of a swimmable beach and just a few minutes’ drive from the best surf spots in the area.The spaceBright & Comfortable Beachfront Home with Ocean ViewsRelax in this cozy beachfront home, where you can enjoy breathtaking ocean views, refreshing sea breezes, and unforgettable sunsets from the spacious terrace. It’s the perfect place to unwind with family and friends while listening to the sound of the waves.The home comfortably accommodates up to 7 guests and features:* Master bedroom with a queen bed* Second bedroom with a full-size bed* Third bedroom with a bunk bed (full on the bottom, twin on the top)You’ll also enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, living room, dining area, air conditioning in all bedrooms, Wi-Fi, and private parking for a comfortable stay.Conveniently located near restaurants, local eateries, supermarkets, and some of Puerto Rico’s best beaches and surf spots on the west coast.Important Beach Information: Our home is located directly on the ocean, and beach conditions naturally change throughout the year due to tides, waves, weather, and coastal erosion. Depending on the season, you may find less sand, rocks, or the ocean closer to the property, which may limit access for swimming. The photos in our listing were taken during different times of the year to accurately reflect these natural changes. If enjoying a wide sandy beach is important to your trip, please contact us before booking. We’ll be happy to provide the latest beach conditions and recommend nearby beaches with excellent swimming and family-friendly conditions.Guest accessDirect Beach Access 🌊Walk down the property’s stairs to enjoy direct access to the beach. Experience the convenience of staying right on the ocean—perfect for beach walks, relaxing with the sea breeze and the sound of the waves, or enjoying the water when conditions allow.Please note: Beach conditions change naturally throughout the year due to tides, waves, weather, and coastal erosion. Depending on the season, you may encounter more or less sand, rocky areas, and the ocean may be closer to the house. These natural changes are beyond our control. If you’d like the latest update on current beach conditions before your arrival, we’d be happy to provide it. However, please note that the beach conditions change throughout the year due to natural factors such as tides, waves, weather, and coastal erosion.During certain times of the year, beach access may be limited, or the sandy shoreline may be significantly reduced. description: Rincón Surf Villa is a bright, clean, and airy 3-bedroom, 2-bath home in the heart of Puntas. Enjoy ocean views from the rooftop deck, perfect for dining and relaxing. Just one minute from Sandy Beach, Domes, Maria’s, and Steps Beach, and close to top restaurants and grocery stores. title: Beachfront Apartment at Pools Beach Rincon "Surf"
description: 1 BR/2BA beachfront apartment with private access to one of the best beaches in Rincon, Puerto Rico- Pools Beach. Queen bed and full size futon style bed in the living area full kitchen, balconies with ocean views, AC in bedroom, cable, Wi-fi, gated parking.The spaceWe are the only vacation rental on beautiful Pools Beach.. Our property includes two apartments that can be rented independently or together as a guesthouse. Each of the 2 units has a master bedroom with a queen bed and a sleeper sofa in the living area. Each apartment can sleep 3 adults or 2 adults + 2 children comfortably. From your balcony you have an unobstructed view of the beach and ocean, enabling you to see whales, surfers, and spectacular sunsets. The break at Pools Beach is a renowned surf destination in Puerto Rico, calm day wading pools next to the house are a treat for all ages!We are within walking distance of restaurants and night life but far enough away that you can just enjoy the sounds of waves. A convenience store, surfing lessons/rentals, and beachfront yoga are also down the street.Our Home is perfect for those seeking a romantic getaway on a quite Caribbean Beach or surfing enthusiasts seeking an amazing beach break. Ours is a hidden gem that keeps quests returning year after year. The local Econo Supermarket is an easy 7 minute drive and has almost everything you would find in the States… The Lighthouse is only 4 to 5 minutes away and a great place to enjoy a sunset. Many more restaurants and culture awaits you in the Rincon Plaza.We are dog friendly for pets under 20lbs.Guest accessThis is a private apartment in a two unit property. Gated parking access is shared, as is beach access and the built in bbq.Other things to noteUnit is on second level, up one flight of stairs.
